name: Yoshihata Natsuhi
source:
Natsuhi is Nao's daughter. When she was little, she treated Shouta like a big brother, but now she has become a gal and is always teasing him.

She is smart, but lately she has become lazy and she is spending more time dating boys than studying, so her grades are declining. Because of that, her mother has hired Shouta as her tutor.
translation:
Natsuhi is Nao's daughter. When she was little, she treated Shouta like a big brother, but now she has become a gal and is always teasing him.

She is smart, but lately she has become lazy and she is spending more time dating boys than studying, so her grades are declining. Because of that, her mother has hired Shouta as her tutor.
